description: This file defines the HolidayService class in the OrangeHRM system, focusing on managing holiday data, including searching, saving, and determining holiday types with cache mechanisms.

classes.name: HolidayService
classes.description: Service class to handle holiday-related operations such as searching, saving, caching, and checking holiday types within the HRM system.

methods.name: getHolidayDao
methods.description: Lazy initialization and retrieval of the HolidayDao object.

methods.name: saveHoliday
methods.description: Saves a Holiday entity and clears associated caches.

methods.name: getHolidaysCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for holiday data within a date range.

methods.name: searchHolidays
methods.description: Retrieves a list of holidays within a date range with optional pagination.

methods.name: searchHolidaysCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of holidays matching search criteria.

methods.name: searchHolidaysAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves holidays from cache or computes and caches the results.

methods.name: getCalculatedHolidays
methods.description: Calculates holidays within a date range, handling recurring and non-recurring holidays.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a specific date is a full-day holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if a specific date is a half-day holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a specific date is a half-day holiday.

methods.name: deleteHolidays
methods.description: Deletes holidays by their IDs and clears caches.
